dc_eval_cbrn.quote: For virology task 2 (SARS-CoV), Opus 4.6 achieved a "max of 5" score of 0.9, exceeding the 0.8 threshold
dc_eval_cbrn.note: CBRN-4 rule-out, uplift trials, virology scores

dc_eval_cyber.quote: Claude Opus 4.6 has saturated all of our current cyber evaluations, achieving ~100% on Cybench (pass@30) and 66% on CyberGym (pass@1).

dc_eval_autonomy.quote: Our determination is that Claude Opus 4.6 does not cross either the AI R&D-4 or the CBRN-4 capability threshold.
dc_eval_autonomy.note: AI R&D-4 threshold determination plus AI research suite scores

dc_eval_persuasion.quote: it is more willing to manipulate or deceive other participants, compared to prior models from both Anthropic and other developers.
dc_eval_persuasion.locator: 6.1.2 Key findings; 6.2.8 External testing from Andon Labs (Vending-Bench 2)
dc_eval_persuasion.note: described manipulation finding from a named test; borderline (behavioural propensity in a multi-agent game, not a persuasion-capability eval). Manipulation also listed as a behaviour looked for in 6.1.1

dc_eval_scheming.quote: the overall evasion success rate in the primary "Extended Thinking" setting, while still quite low (18%), was significantly higher than it was for previous models.

framework_threshold.quote: Based on these assessments, we have decided to release Claude Opus 4.6 under the ASL-3 Standard.
framework_threshold.note: RSP ASL-3; AI R&D-4 and CBRN-4 not crossed

ext_test_any.quote: pre-deployment testing of Claude Opus 4.6 was conducted by the US Center for AI Standards and Innovation (CAISI) and the UK AI Security Institute (UK AISI).
ext_test_any.note: also Apollo Research, Andon Labs, Gray Swan, expert red teamers

ext_test_named_org.quote: Apollo Research was given access to an early checkpoint of Claude Opus 4.6 on January 24th and an additional checkpoint on January 26th.
ext_test_named_org.note: named outside organisation; inconclusive but testing occurred

ext_test_government.quote: we shared a pre-release snapshot of Claude Opus 4.6 with the UK AI Security Institute for open-ended testing
ext_test_government.locator: 6.2.6 External testing from the UK AI Security Institute

ext_test_timing_stated.quote: pre-deployment testing of Claude Opus 4.6 was conducted by the US Center for AI Standards and Innovation (CAISI) and the UK AI Security Institute (UK AISI).

safeguards_training.quote: Claude Opus 4.6 underwent substantial post-training and fine-tuning, with the intention of making it a helpful, honest, and harmless1 assistant.

safeguards_runtime.quote: we are implementing new and enhanced safeguards against cyber misuse. These safeguards include efficient probes for faster detection.
safeguards_runtime.note: probes, real-time blocking; also prompt-injection classifiers (5.2)

safeguards_access.quote: Claude.ai, our consumer offering, is only available to users aged 18 or above, and we continue to work on implementing robust child safety measures
safeguards_access.note: age restriction in child-safety context; borderline, the card ties it to safety only by placement in the child-safety section

safeguards_weights.quote: This is one of the two safeguards AI R&D-4 requires, the other being ASL-3 security, under which Claude Opus 4.6 is deployed.
safeguards_weights.note: deployed under ASL-3 Security Standard; card links security standards to model-weight theft (fn 59). Borderline: weights not named in the same span
